name: Thieving Skydiver
oracle_text:
Kicker {X}. X can't be 0. (You may pay an additional {X} as you cast this spell.)
Flying
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, gain control of target artifact with mana value X or less. If that artifact is an Equipment, attach it to this creature.

needs.what: a floor on a spell's announced X ("X can't be 0", X >= 1) that applies to the kicked cast line of a card whose kicker is {X}, so the kicked line is offered only when at least {1} extra is payable and the CHOOSE_X question starts at 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `kicker: "{X}"` folds the X into the paid cost via ManaCost.plus and the permanent's cast_x reaches its enters trigger, but Game._cast asks X with min_x taken only from player_statics.cast_lock_min_x (a mana-value lock like Brisela), defaulting to 0. Without a card-level floor the spell can be kicked for X = 0 and steal a mana-value-0 artifact, which the printed card forbids. The trigger itself is otherwise expressible: an intervening-if `kicked` condition, a target artifact with mana_value <= x, gain_control, then an `if` on the target being an Equipment around `attach`
